en.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Choose a photo for your baby’s profile or a custom food. Photos are stored only on this device.
en.NSCameraUsageDescription: The Nursing Queen uses the camera only if you choose to take a new photo for your baby's profile.

ar.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: اختاري صورة لملف طفلك أو لطعام خاص. تُحفظ الصور على هذا الجهاز فقط.
